author: Yatamanyu Narain
title: Rashmika Mandanna Reveals Why She Avoids Work Talk With Her Partner: 'I Only Ask For Help When...' | Telugu Cinema News - News18
text: Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda continue to dominate headlines, not for a film announcement, but for their long-circulating engagement rumours. Reports recently claimed that Vijay’s team has confirmed that the two are already engaged and may tie the knot in February next year. Neither actor has publicly addressed the speculation, nor have they shared any pictures to confirm or deny it — but the conversation around their relationship refuses to slow down. When Asked About Having an Actor as a Partner… Though Rashmika has never officially referred to Vijay as her partner or fiancé, a recent interview brought the topic front and centre. During a conversation with Anupama Chopra for The Hollywood Reporter India, she was asked how it feels when “your partner is from the same profession" — the question framed through the example of Alia Bhatt and Ranbir Kapoor. Alia has previously said that she doesn’t discuss acting or craft with Ranbir, and Rashmika was asked whether the same applies to her and Vijay. “When I’m Home, I Just Want to Be Home" Responding thoughtfully, Rashmika explained that she tries to draw a line between her personal and professional life, “As much as we are actors, I want to cut off from work when I go home. At least 80 percent of the time, I don’t. If something is bothering me, I go and ask for advice or help. At home, I want to cut off from work because you cannot be 24/7 at work." She added that even talking about work counts as being in work mode, “Talking about work is still work. When I’m at work or in a meeting, I give my 100 percent, but when I’m at home, I’m at home. I’m that kind of a person." Rashmika On Protecting Her Personal Space The actress went on to say that she doesn’t discuss films or industry matters with her family either, “We are actors and work doesn’t leave us, but with my mother, dad or anyone in my family, I don’t talk about work. I take my personal life extremely seriously. I’ve made it a thing — I don’t want to talk about work." On The Work Front Rashmika has had a strong year professionally, with Chhaava and The Girlfriend both earning wide attention. She is currently shooting Cocktail 2 alongside Kriti Sanon and Shahid Kapoor.
